evidence.quote: By increasing temperature up to 300 ℃, similar to room temperature, stretched and broken dendrites wi th a slight deviation in the direction of the load are formed.
a greater number of broken dendrites along with a higher fraction of LAGBs can be detected compared to that of room temperature condition.
